summary: Pop Culture Group Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 8, 2026 to announce a 10-for-1 share consolidation of its Class A, B, and C ordinary shares, effective July 13, 2026. The reverse stock split reduces outstanding Class A shares from ~113.8M to ~11.4M with fractional shares rounded up. The company's shares will continue trading on Nasdaq under symbol CPOP with a new CUSIP. Stock options and warrants are proportionally adjusted. This is a routine corporate action to meet exchange listing standards, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or M&A activity is involved.
